pages.text: Weavers are spider-like creatures with a distinct abdomen consisting of a rotating Memory Core. They use this organ to store the memories they extract from their victims and later weave them into Bloodweave. They will attack any living creature and as a side effect of consuming memories, the target will experience short-term Amnesia. They can only be found in colonies where they form large

nests - such as in Great Bodies. Upon death, they can drop Bones and rarely a Memory Core. These can be consumed as is, to gain experience, or used to craft a Concentration Core, which is a vital component for Willful weapons. A Weaver that wanders out of its colony has the capability to create a new Weaver Nest once it has
consumed sufficient memories. This process will kill the Weaver but the newly created Nest will birth forth new Weavers at a slow but steady rate.
The Amnesia they cause can easily lead the victim into panic and danger.
